segments.subtask: The robot arm is positioned over the green mat with a pink food item and two baskets.
The robot arm moves to the left side and grasps the black object with the left gripper.
The robot arm moves the black object to the left basket and places it inside.
The robot arm moves to the right side and grasps the pink food item with the right gripper.
The robot arm moves the pink food item to the right basket and places it inside.
The robot arm moves back to the green mat and grasps the black object with the left gripper.
The robot arm moves the black object to the left basket and places it inside.
The robot arm moves to the right side and grasps the pink food item with the right gripper.
